technique_name: Describe the role and importance of artificial intelligence today
description: Artificial intelligence has become an important part of our modern world, and its use is growing exponentially. It is used in many areas, such as computer vision, natural language processing, healthcare, finance and many more. AI can be used to automate processes, identify trends, and even provide new insights and solutions to challenging problems.
